name: – Recital C – Am 55
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: C.whereas between 29 and 31 July 2026, approximately 80 000 migrants crossed irregularly into Ceuta from Morocco, by land and sea, and several hundred crossed into Melilla; whereas at least 141 people lost their lives at sea trying to reach Ceuta; whereas most of the people who died have not yet been identified; whereas the families of the few identified bodies have not been able to have them repatriated to Morrocco because of the Moroccan authorities’ refusal;
